title: Waze map in the layout's window
description: Installed with Cluster Layouts. While a layout shows with Centre: Waze, Waze on cluster draws its map in the layout's window, filling it, with nothing of BMW's own map screen showing; turn the layout off (Cluster Layouts' Show button) and the map goes back to the stock cluster's place. Each switch restarts Waze on cluster: the map comes back after a few seconds. It also finds the song's cover art where the head unit keeps it, when Cluster Layouts asks (Settings > Cover art).
